source.label: U.S. Census Bureau · 2024 American Community Survey 1-year
filters: 2024 annual estimates; 50 states + District of Columbia; national benchmark is published separately.

evidenceFlow.title: Original federal public-domain data
evidenceFlow.detail: Official Census table-based Summary File downloads, retrieved 2026-10-09; no account, key, or individual records. CC0 1.0 identified in the official Data.gov catalog record ACSDT1Y2024.

evidenceFlow.title: Exact geography join
evidenceFlow.detail: Retain 0100000US and 0400000US + the 50 state/DC FIPS codes. Join tables one-to-one on exact GEO_ID and fixed 2024 vintage. Exclude Puerto Rico and other summary levels.

evidenceFlow.title: Reconciliation
evidenceFlow.detail: 52 unique geography rows. No missing or unexpected negative analytical values. B25070 total = B25106 renter total; income-band totals + no-cash-rent + zero/negative-income counts = renter total; burden numerators reconcile across both tables.

caveats: 2024 survey estimates, not current asking rents or individual financial advice. Dollars are 2024 USD. State averages hide within-state differences.
Each state has equal visual weight; nationwide medians and percentages come from the U.S. row, never an average of states.

Rent burden excludes no-cash-rent and zero/negative-income households. Those records remain visible as not computed, never recoded as affordable. Renter household median income includes all renter households.

Error bars are approximate 90% intervals for derived percentages. They ignore covariance unavailable in published table MOEs; small differences and rankings are not necessarily meaningful. Published medians retain published 90% MOEs.
Associations describe places and income groups. No causal or household-level inference is made.

metricDefinitions.label: Median monthly gross rent
metricDefinitions.definition: B25064: median monthly contract rent plus utilities and fuels, for renter-occupied housing units paying cash rent; 2024 USD.

metricDefinitions.label: Rent burden ≥30%
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 × sum(B25070 cells 007–010) ÷ (cell 001 − cell 011). Denominator contains renter households with computed gross-rent-to-income ratios.

metricDefinitions.label: Approximate 90% margins of error
metricDefinitions.definition: Derived sum/difference MOEs use root-sum-of-squares. Subset-proportion MOE: 100/D × sqrt(MOE_N² − (N/D)² × MOE_D²); if negative radicand, use plus in place of minus. Percent intervals clipped to 0–100. These approximations do not account for unavailable covariance.

metricDefinitions.label: Income-band comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: B25106 renter income groups among cash-rent households with positive income; each row shows the share paying 30%+ within that band. Annual income is 2024 inflation-adjusted USD.

metricDefinitions.label: Public domain and non-endorsement
metricDefinitions.definition: Official Data.gov dataset ACSDT1Y2024 lists CC0 1.0. This product uses Census Bureau data but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.

source.label: U.S. Census Bureau · 2024 American Community Survey 1-year
filters: 2024 annual estimates; 50 states + District of Columbia; national benchmark is published separately.

evidenceFlow.title: Original federal public-domain data
evidenceFlow.detail: Official Census table-based Summary File downloads, retrieved 2026-10-09; no account, key, or individual records. CC0 1.0 identified in the official Data.gov catalog record ACSDT1Y2024.

evidenceFlow.title: Exact geography join
evidenceFlow.detail: Retain 0100000US and 0400000US + the 50 state/DC FIPS codes. Join tables one-to-one on exact GEO_ID and fixed 2024 vintage. Exclude Puerto Rico and other summary levels.

evidenceFlow.title: Reconciliation
evidenceFlow.detail: 52 unique geography rows. No missing or unexpected negative analytical values. B25070 total = B25106 renter total; income-band totals + no-cash-rent + zero/negative-income counts = renter total; burden numerators reconcile across both tables.

caveats: 2024 survey estimates, not current asking rents or individual financial advice. Dollars are 2024 USD. State averages hide within-state differences.
Each state has equal visual weight; nationwide medians and percentages come from the U.S. row, never an average of states.

Rent burden excludes no-cash-rent and zero/negative-income households. Those records remain visible as not computed, never recoded as affordable. Renter household median income includes all renter households.

Error bars are approximate 90% intervals for derived percentages. They ignore covariance unavailable in published table MOEs; small differences and rankings are not necessarily meaningful. Published medians retain published 90% MOEs.
Associations describe places and income groups. No causal or household-level inference is made.

metricDefinitions.label: Median monthly gross rent
metricDefinitions.definition: B25064: median monthly contract rent plus utilities and fuels, for renter-occupied housing units paying cash rent; 2024 USD.

metricDefinitions.label: Rent burden ≥30%
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 × sum(B25070 cells 007–010) ÷ (cell 001 − cell 011). Denominator contains renter households with computed gross-rent-to-income ratios.

metricDefinitions.label: Approximate 90% margins of error
metricDefinitions.definition: Derived sum/difference MOEs use root-sum-of-squares. Subset-proportion MOE: 100/D × sqrt(MOE_N² − (N/D)² × MOE_D²); if negative radicand, use plus in place of minus. Percent intervals clipped to 0–100. These approximations do not account for unavailable covariance.

metricDefinitions.label: Income-band comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: B25106 renter income groups among cash-rent households with positive income; each row shows the share paying 30%+ within that band. Annual income is 2024 inflation-adjusted USD.

metricDefinitions.label: Public domain and non-endorsement
metricDefinitions.definition: Official Data.gov dataset ACSDT1Y2024 lists CC0 1.0. This product uses Census Bureau data but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.

metadata.title: The Rent Squeeze
metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 ACS 1-year Detailed Tables
metadata.grain: 50 states + District of Columbia; U.S. benchmark separate
metadata.interval: 90% confidence interval; published MOEs for counts and medians, approximate derived MOEs for percentages
metadata.primaryDenominator: Renter-occupied housing units with computable gross-rent-to-income ratio, excluding no cash rent and zero/negative household income.
